scope: Sim2Claw repository organization; existing evidence paths remain unchanged
classification_authority: Advisory path metadata; native owners, active work and evidence bindings take precedence
entry_matching: Apply overrides first, then the most specific applicable path entry; no executable classifier is provided

overrides.condition: A path is sealed, reserved, held-out, evaluator-owned, a symlink or inside a nested repository
overrides.reason: A directory inventory does not grant access to protected evidence or another repository

overrides.condition: A path is tracked, staged or bound by a retained receipt, regardless of ignore rules or directory name
overrides.reason: Existing Git tracking and proof bindings win over generated-root assumptions

overrides.condition: A process owns the artifact, another task is modifying it, or activity and ownership are unknown
overrides.reason: A process snapshot or absent lock does not prove that deletion or relocation is safe

entries.related_files: Any SQLite journal, WAL or SHM sidecars for this database belong to the same live database
entries.reason: Human annotations are not reconstructible from the search index or original receipts

entries.related_files: SQLite sidecars belong to the live index; this policy does not authorize their removal
entries.regeneration: The existing ops index command rebuilds the index from admitted local source bytes
entries.reason: The index is a repository-root-bound search projection; the adjacent journal is separate user data

entries.regeneration: The existing ops report command produces a new current snapshot, not necessarily the original historical view
entries.reason: A derived report can still be a useful record of what a reviewer saw

entries.owner: Author of the referenced review or verification receipt
entries.reason: Re-running an audit creates new evidence and does not reproduce the original review receipt

entries.owner: Native experiment, data, release or tool owner; unknown until classified
entries.reason: These broad roots mix inputs, media, receipts, releases and temporary files; ignored does not mean disposable

receipt_principles: Retain standalone receipt source snapshots and manifests at their existing paths
Git already deduplicates identical content blobs; repeated snapshot paths do not imply repeated Git object storage
A matching checksum identifies bytes; it does not establish semantic validity or task success
No artifact is deleted, moved, reset, untracked or staged by this metadata policy
future_gate: Any executable cleanup or archival tool needs a separate reviewed plan with exact targets, owner and activity checks, proof-binding checks, a preservation or rollback path and measured verification
